target.statement: SOC baseline achieves 67.5 J&F on Ref-Youtube-VOS validation set

compute.basis: Training SOC (Video Swin Transformer + RoBERTa) for 30 epochs on RefCOCO + Ref-Youtube-VOS and evaluating on 202 validation videos requires a GPU; on CPU-only laptop this is impractical, and even with a GPU it takes many hours.

blockers: Requires training SOC on RefCOCO and Ref-Youtube-VOS, which needs a GPU
Ref-Youtube-VOS dataset is large (tens of GB) and requires registration/download
No pretrained SOC checkpoint is linked in the paper; only challenge solution code is provided
title: 1st Place Solution for 5th LSVOS Challenge: Referring Video Object Segmentation
